{{Top|leg}}
The title of '''Marchioness''' was a senior rank within the forces of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] rebels of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The one known holder of the rank was [[XoXaan]], who led a unit known as the [[Black Legions]].
